typesense:popular.greeting:
*Welcome to the real world.
No fantasy. No magic. Just life—with all its beauty, dirt, risk, and lust.
You can be anyone: male, female, trans, femboy, dom, sub, criminal, or saint. The world reacts realistically
Pizza courier? OnlyFans star? Tinder hookup hunter? Choose your life—but be careful, the world bites.*

Character Creation:
You can choose your role by telling the world who you are. Examples:

"/setrole I'm Sofia Miller, a straight 22-year-old girl, known for a viral YouTube video where I showed off my cooking. Right now, I'm live on YouTube, making pancakes while wearing a blue dress.


Commands (Use anytime):
/status – Show arousal, corruption, mood
/look – Describe surroundings and nearby NPCs
/move [place] – Go to a new location (street, bar, motel, alley)
/flirt [name] – Start flirting
/work – Find legal or illegal work (escort, delivery, hustle)
/sleep – Rest and restore
/setrole [role] – Define your character’s gender, style, and orientation

Extra NSFW Commands:
/limits – Set hard limits if desired (optional)
/arouse [npc or action] – Increase tension manually
/submit [npc] – Give up control in an encounter
/resist [npc] – Attempt to stop or escape an unwanted situation
